Fixed: Retain Sunday evening bars that belong to a Monday CME exchange session.
Apply max_single_weight symmetrically to requested long and short target weights.
Include futures contract multipliers in the affected simple-cash and sequential buying-power reservation checks.
Return positive infinite CAGR when annualizing an extreme short positive-return window overflows, so EquityCurve.to_dict completes.
Keep the shared comparison group compatible with Plotly below 7 on Python below 3.15 and regenerate all isolated lock metadata.
Documentation: Correct executor-mode configuration, fill-eligibility descriptions, headroom and whole-share target rounding. Link the rebalancing guide to the enum, configuration and executor API reference.
Make the Zipline migration guide explicit about input and execution assumptions, with a checked synthetic target-weight example and a link to the tested Diagnostic portfolio-analysis handoff.
Publish the local contribution guide and issue/PR templates linked to the shared policy, preserving private security reporting and the verified usage-documentation destination.
Build and compatibility: Update the build backend, pinned workflow actions and vulnerable dependency locks while preserving the frozen comparison framework identities.
Accept final CPython 3.15 in the canary and describe its steps accurately. Stable support remains CPython 3.12 through 3.14; no blanket optional-package support for 3.15 is added.
Compatibility: Results change in the corrected overnight-session, short-target and futures-cash cases. Target caps apply before whole unit rounding and do not guarantee a continuous limit on realized exposure.
Consumers of raw metric dictionaries must handle non-finite CAGR for extreme short windows. Versioned result exports retain their documented tagged JSON encoding for non-finite metrics.
Validation: Regenerate correctness evidence from frozen inputs and preserve original timing measurements, using the existing source-certification mechanism for documentation-only source changes.

Changed: Complete task guides and the verified Book Guide with installed-wheel examples.
Correct User Guide API examples and explanations of strategy state.
Add an audited User Guide with task navigation.
Correct backtest behavior, add guided documentation and refresh the build backend.
Reconcile time zones before trade enrichment, improve verification of newly published packages, and complete the closure documentation audit.
Remove the inert LinearImpact.permanent_fraction parameter and add provenance-preserving source certification for performance evidence.
Standardize ecosystem setup and public agent orientation.
Publish bounded real-strategy comparisons and timing evidence, and authenticate licensed VectorBT Pro installation through GitHub CLI.
Use the feed VWAP for VWAP execution and reject unavailable required VWAP prices.
Update pinned GitHub Actions.

Tagged source: The annotated v0.1.2 tag exists. No matching published release or artifact is currently listed in the GitHub/PyPI records checked on 2026-10-15. See [tagged source](https://github.com/ml4t/backtest/tree/v0.1.2).

Changed: Add per-asset position rules for pre-open execution.

Added: Versioned compatibility snapshots, beta-artifact migration fixtures, commit-bound release candidates, and exact publication verification.
Deterministic parity-claim generation and five reproducible performance workloads with behavior checksums.
Installed-wheel execution checks for the primary installation and quickstart examples.
A versioned causal strategy lifecycle and canonical pre-open target intents shared with ml4t-live, including child-order lineage, reconciliation evidence, and post-fill position-rule activation.
Changed: Broker state now has explicit account, market, order, risk, and execution-journal owners while the Broker remains the public facade.
Intraday session enforcement now filters actual exchange intervals, including early closes and breaks, using the configured timezone for naive timestamps.
DataFeed now rejects a missing resolved reference-price column at construction and documents close-only fallbacks explicitly.
Stable distribution metadata, release-critical static analysis, and the 250-asset performance workload now match the 0.1 release contract.

Weekly and month-end rebalance schedules require calendar metadata and use the final scheduled exchange session rather than the last available feed bar. Holidays do not move a rebalance earlier, and a missing completed period-end session raises a feed-completeness error.

Explicit rebalance timestamps match absolute instants across timezone representations and online evaluation requires chronological events. A scheduled instant inside the observed feed window that has no matching event raises an alignment error instead of being skipped silently.
Batch and online session schedules require every complete exchange session to match its required close; only an incomplete final session is exempt, and calendar mismatches fail explicitly.
Result artifacts retain intent and lifecycle counts by default. Set retain_intent_history or retain_lifecycle_history to include the corresponding event histories.
Morning-start exchange sessions group pre-market and regular-hours events under the same local calendar date; exchange session labels and opens come from cached authoritative calendar schedules.
Scheduled TargetWeightExecutor.execute calls register completion validation with the Engine, so missing required closes and partial event coverage fail the run with distinct diagnostics.

Deferred next-open risk exits fill before opening targets are sized. Fractional accounts reject largest-remainder residual handling regardless of rounding because its whole-unit allocation cannot redistribute fractional remainders; use keep-cash instead.
Fixed: Financial-accounting, order-rejection, artifact-integrity, quantity-tolerance, and parity-comparison defects found during the stable-release audit.
Cross-framework validation now fails incomplete runs and requires exact retained comparisons for supported scenarios.

Batch and online session schedules apply the same daily-close fallback when data frequency and timestamp semantics are both omitted. Batch evaluation and flagless online evaluation reject repeated dates and intervals under 12 hours as ambiguous intraday data; online events may instead carry is_session_close consistently, but mixing explicit and inferred boundaries on one date raises.
Session-aligned P&L and broker statistics interpret naive timestamps in the configured data timezone before applying the authoritative exchange timezone.
Compatibility: Stable support requires CPython 3.12 through 3.14 on Linux, macOS, and Windows; CPython 3.15 prereleases are blocking compatibility checks until final release.
Manifest-free 0.1.0b22 result artifacts require explicit recovery mode and can then be rewritten as schema-versioned stable artifacts.
The ambiguous beta-only Broker(account_type=...) constructor spelling was removed; use explicit short-selling and leverage policy fields.
Engine instances are single-use in 0.1.0; create a new Engine for each independent run.
BacktestResult fills, equity_curve, and portfolio_state lists are snapshots instead of aliases to mutable Engine or Broker state.

The beta-only on_before_risk callback and future-timestamp on_prepare signature are removed. Engine construction raises HistoricalStrategyCompatibilityError for strategies that require either historical behavior.
TargetWeightExecutor.prepare_schedule was removed. Configure calendar, timezone, session_start_time, data_frequency, and timestamp_semantics on RebalanceConfig for causal schedule evaluation.
Custom morning session_start_time values are rejected; morning-start sessions always use the local calendar date. Omit the override or restate the configured exchange calendar's standard open.
Evening session_start_time overrides remain available for calendar-free and evening-start sessions, but are rejected for calendars whose authoritative open is in the morning.
SessionConfig is immutable; construct and install a replacement instead of mutating calendar, timezone, or session_start_time after configuration.
ExecutionPolicy.liquidity_fraction now applies only to opening-auction target children. Configure Engine execution_limits explicitly to constrain ordinary strategy orders.
Validation: Release requires compatibility, correctness, coverage, documentation, lint, packaging, parity, performance, security, and type-check gates bound to one commit.
The exact wheel and source distribution that pass those gates are retained as the release candidate and verified after publication.

Added: Strategy.on_before_risk(), explicit position-rule clearing, and an opt-in entry-bar trailing-watermark mode.
Compatibility: Strategies that do not override on_before_risk retain their prior behavior. The callback remains beta-only and is scheduled for explicit migration rather than inclusion in the stable lifecycle.

Added: Broker.equity() as the preferred marked-account-equity accessor.
Compatibility: Broker.get_account_value() remains available and delegates to equity().

Fixed: RiskManager.update(..., broker=...) now applies liquidation actions by flattening positions instead of only reporting the breach.
Compatibility: Liquidation behavior changes only when a portfolio limit returns action='liquidate' and a broker is supplied. Omitting the broker retains reporting behavior and emits a warning.

Added: Broker.flatten_all_positions() and the typed risk_liquidation exit reason for portfolio-wide breaches.
Compatibility: Existing strategy exits are unchanged; portfolio risk integrations can opt into explicit flattening and preserve the liquidation cause.

Added: Per-symbol percentage-of-notional margin schedules for price-aware futures margin assumptions.
Compatibility: Existing global and fixed-dollar margin settings remain valid. Defining the same asset in fixed_margin_schedule and margin_pct_schedule is rejected as ambiguous.
